name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ClassLock.cover_flip_high_covered
title: A cover flip at a level L >= l is class-covered: every string alive in the new slot is alive in the old slot or in the cover, both of the new slot's class
statement: Let slots d and c agree at all levels below L, c have entry 1 at (L, b) and only 1-entries after L, and l <= L. If m' agrees with d except possibly at (L, b), then every string alive in m' is alive in d or in c, and both d and c have the same entries as m' at every level below l.
